title: Managing the impact of noise element objectives
text: O 4.7.1 The siting and layout of development minimises the impact of external noise sources and provides appropriate acoustic privacy to dwellings and on-site open space. O 4.7.2 Acoustic treatments are used to reduce sound transfer within and between dwellings and to reduce noise transmission from external noise sources.
notes: Objectives the Acceptable Outcomes of this element fall back to; text cleaned of column interleaving.
